title: WavCube: Unifying Speech Representation for Understanding and Generation via Semantic-Acoustic Joint Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2605.06407v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Integrating speech understanding and generation is a pivotal step toward building unified speech models. However, the different representations required for these two tasks currently pose significant compatibility challenges. Typically, semantics-oriented features are learned from self-supervised learning (SSL), and acoustic-oriented features from reconstruction. Such fragmented representations hinder the realization of truly unified speech systems. We present WavCube, a compact continuous latent derived from an SSL speech encoder that simultaneously supports speech understanding, reconstruction, and generation. WavCube employs a two-stage training scheme. Stage 1 trains a semantic bottleneck to filter off-manifold redundancy that makes raw SSL features intractable for diffusion. Stage 2 injects fine-grained acoustic details via end-to-end reconstruction, while a semantic anchoring loss ensures the representation remains ground

translated_title: WavCube：通过语义-声学联合建模统一用于语音理解与生成的语音表征
translated_abstract: 将语音理解与语音生成整合是构建统一语音模型的关键一步。然而，这两项任务所需的不同表征目前带来了显著的兼容性挑战。通常，面向语义的特征通过自监督学习（SSL）获得，而面向声学的特征则通过重建获得。这种碎片化的表征阻碍了真正统一的语音系统的实现。我们提出了WavCube，一种源自SSL语音编码器的紧凑连续潜在表征，可同时支持语音理解、重建和生成。WavCube采用两阶段训练方案：第一阶段训练语义瓶颈，滤除使原始SSL特征难以用于扩散模型的流形外冗余；第二阶段通过端到端重建注入细粒度声学细节，同时利用语义锚定损失确保表征始终保持语义稳定。
tldr: WavCube通过“语义瓶颈过滤+端到端声学重建”的两阶段训练，提出了一个源自SSL编码器的紧凑连续语音表征，首次同时支持语音理解、重建与生成任务。
en_tdlr: WavCube introduces a compact continuous speech representation derived from an SSL encoder that unifies speech understanding, reconstruction, and generation via a two-stage training scheme combining semantic bottleneck filtering and end-to-end acoustic reconstruction.
